coverage: Five complete descriptor concept-and-term records: Deglutition Disorders, Cerebrovascular Disorders, Stroke, Brain Ischemia and Ischemic Attack, Transient; their concepts, terms and explicit typed edges support only their stated purposes. An independently counted, paginated official MeSH 2026 projection additionally covers all 81 descriptors, 240 concepts and 626 terms in the Cerebrovascular Disorders typed descriptor family for hold-only conditional-instruction checks. This is not the complete MeSH release, universal clinical synonym coverage, or an ICD mapping. Positive narrower-concept proof is limited to the three explicitly listed nec_relation_roots; the two additional raw descriptors and complete cerebrovascular family are condition-checking material only.

use_terms.basis: No charges, fees or royalties; acknowledge NLM, do not imply endorsement, and identify this fixed MeSH 2026 version.

conditional_families.purpose: Hold-only optional-instruction condition vocabulary; no positive NEC relation or code assignment.

count.query: PREFIX meshv: <http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/vocab#> SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { SELECT DISTINCT ?descriptor ?parent ?concept ?term ?label WHERE { ?descriptor meshv:broaderDescriptor* <http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/2026/D002561> . ?descriptor (meshv:preferredConcept|meshv:concept) ?concept . ?concept (meshv:preferredTerm|meshv:term) ?term . ?term meshv:prefLabel ?label . OPTIONAL { ?descriptor meshv:broaderDescriptor ?parent . } } }

pages.query: PREFIX meshv: <http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/vocab#> SELECT DISTINCT ?descriptor ?parent ?concept ?term ?label WHERE { ?descriptor meshv:broaderDescriptor* <http://id.nlm.nih.gov/mesh/2026/D002561> . ?descriptor (meshv:preferredConcept|meshv:concept) ?concept . ?concept (meshv:preferredTerm|meshv:term) ?term . ?term meshv:prefLabel ?label . OPTIONAL { ?descriptor meshv:broaderDescriptor ?parent . } } ORDER BY ?descriptor ?parent ?concept ?term ?label LIMIT 1000 OFFSET 0
